title: Nine Days in a Dish
subtitle: 生命科学 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 生命科学（科学与技术·生物与生命科学）
meta: 主题语境：生命科学（科学与技术·生物与生命科学）　|　核心词汇：bacteria　|　正文 321 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 bacteria 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1961 my brother grew ① bacteria in a dish for a school project and was told to throw it away, which he did not. The ② bacteria, meaning the things in the dish and not the word, doubled nine times in a week and frightened nobody; bacteria, my mother said, are the only living things that do all their work where you cannot see it. She said that is what frightened her.

Every ③ bacteria in that dish came from the same spoon, and he said that was the experiment. Their ④ bacteria — the ones the teacher wrote about — had nine names and none of them were English; bacteria, my father said, are the only living things that are counted in millions and described in Latin. He said the Latin was the expensive part.

My grandmother said ⑤ bacteria were what her mother had called dirt, and she said the new word had not improved anything. The ⑥ bacteria, meaning the idea and not the dish, are nine parts fear and one part soap; bacteria, my mother said, are the only thing in a house that everybody blames and nobody has seen. She said the blaming goes on for years.

By 1963 the ⑦ bacteria had been poured down the sink and the dish had been used for nine years as a saucer. The ⑧ bacteria in the water, the inspector wrote in March, were the reason for the notice on the door; bacteria, my father said, are either a school project or a public danger, depending on who is looking. He said the inspector was looking very hard.

The ⑨ bacteria I remember are the ones in the dish, which he drew nine times and never once looked at properly. ⑩ Bacteria, my grandmother said in 1969, are the only living things that are safer the less you know about them; every one of them, she said, is doing something, and it is never what you think.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义

answers.why: grow bacteria 意为“培养细菌”，1961 年弟弟为一个学校作业在碟子里培养细菌，被要求扔掉，他没扔。
bacteria 指“碟子里那些东西”，与这个词相对，它们一个星期内翻了九倍，谁也没被吓着。
bacteria 意为“细菌”，那只碟子里所有细菌都来自同一把勺子，他说那就是实验。
bacteria 指老师写下的、有九个名字的那一些细菌，那些名字没有一个是英文的。
bacteria 为抽象总称，泛指“细菌这种东西”，祖母说细菌就是她母亲当年叫作脏东西的东西。
bacteria 意为“细菌这个概念”，与那只碟子相对，是九分恐惧加一分肥皂。
bacteria 指被倒进水槽的那些，到 1963 年那些细菌被倒进了水槽，那只碟子当茶托用了九年。
bacteria 指水里的那些，督察三月写道，水里的那些细菌就是门上那张告示的原因。
bacteria 意为“细菌”，我记得的是碟子里那些，他画了九次，却一次也没认真看过。
bacteria 为抽象总称，祖母说细菌是唯一你了解得越少就越安全的生物。
